scientific_question: Can a closed-form diagonal approximation to the selected Givens tangent metric preserve most of the 300-step fitted oracle's causal current-update and future-direction recovery across all 20 layer/phase cells?

analytic_update.formula: For every selected hidden pair (i,j), angle_ij = <requested_update, d(W R_ij)/d angle at zero> / (||W[:,i]||^2 + ||W[:,j]||^2).
analytic_update.interpretation: This is the exact one-coordinate least-squares solution at the identity and a diagonal approximation to the joint selected-tangent normal equations.

causal_protocol: Current exact coherent Muon state selects hidden-channel perfect matchings. Closed-form angles use only the current scheduled Muon update. The future phase chord remains inaccessible until scoring. Equal-size deterministic random matchings use the identical analytic update.

decision_rule.pass: implement a refreshable folded-base production representation with exact connectivity, angle, refresh, and serialization provenance, then require a directly polled real-training MFU certificate at or above 20 percent; scientific training remains unauthorized until both are complete
decision_rule.fail: do not implement this diagonal approximation as training code; preregister and evaluate a small fixed number of matrix-free normal-equation iterations such as conjugate gradient

execution_policy: Run directly in the foreground on one idle Y400 GPU and poll to exit. Do not use a watchdog, callback, queue worker, heartbeat, or PRO6.
